title: Besiboli ya kitaalamu ya Korea ina saa ya kurusha mpira

text.⚾ WHAT SURPRISED ME AT A KOREAN BALLPARK: ⚾ KILICHONISHANGAZA KATIKA UWANJA WA BESIBOLI WA KOREA
text.Korean pro baseball has a pitch clock: Besiboli ya kitaalamu ya Korea ina saa ya kurusha mpira
Besiboli ya kitaalamu ya Korea ilikuwa na saa ya kurusha mpira.
text.Baseball is a sport where games are just: Besiboli ni mchezo ambao mechi zake ni ndefu tu.
text.Maybe because of that, Major League Base: Labda kwa sababu hiyo, Major League Baseball ina sheria: “Mrushaji lazima arushe mpira unaofuata ndani ya sekunde 15 hadi 20 hivi.”
Hii ndiyo saa ya kurusha mpira.
text.⏱️ The orange “13” next to the scoreboar: ⏱️ Namba “13” ya rangi ya machungwa karibu na ubao wa alama
text.In the photo, the “13” shining next to t: Katika picha, “13” inayong'aa karibu na ubao wa alama ndiyo muda uliobaki.
text.I was surprised that Korean pro baseball: Nilishangaa kwamba besiboli ya kitaalamu ya Korea nayo ina hii.
text.Actually, Japanese pro baseball does not: Kwa kweli, besiboli ya kitaalamu ya Japani haina saa ya kurusha mpira.
Kwa hivyo mechi nchini Japani ni ndefu kidogo.
text.The pitcher stands still for about 20 se: Mrushaji husimama tuli kwa sekunde 20 hivi bila kurusha, na hucheza mchezo wa akili na mchezaji wa mpini.
text.That may also be part of what makes Japa: Hilo pengine ni sehemu ya kile kinachofanya besiboli ya Kijapani kuwa ya Kijapani.
text.But because of that, it seems Japan has: Lakini kwa sababu hiyo, inaonekana Japani hupata shida katika mashindano ya kimataifa.
text.There is a tournament called the WBC (Wo: Kuna mashindano yanayoitwa WBC (World Baseball Classic), kama Kombe la Dunia la besiboli.
text.Japan is a country with very strong pitc: Japani ni nchi yenye warushaji hodari sana.
text.Back when there was no pitch clock, Japa: Wakati hakuna saa ya kurusha mpira, warushaji wa Kijapani walikuwa vigumu kupigwa, na Japani imeshinda mashindano hayo.
text.But after the pitch clock came in, Japan: Lakini baada ya saa ya kurusha mpira kuanzishwa, warushaji wa Kijapani hawakuweza kuendana na kasi hiyo na wakaanza kupigwa.
